spans.s:
उदेजय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Shaking, making tremble.
 E. उद् before एज् to
tremble, श aff.

उद्देश m. (-शः)
 1. Illustration, explanation, exemplification.
 2.
Search, enquiry.
 3. Stipulation, bargain.
 4. An object, a motive.
mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Relative to.
 E. उद् and देश showing.

उद्देशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What explains or shows, illustrative, explana-
tory.
 m. (-कः)
 1. An illustration, an example.
 2. An illustrator.
3. A guide.
 E. उद् before दिश् to show, वुन् aff.

उद्देश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be illustrated or explained.
 E. उद्, दिश् to
show, ण्यत् aff.
उद्देहिका f. (-का) The white ant, termes; also उत्यादिका.
